desc:
THE WAR IS OVER. THE WORLD IS IN RUINS. YOUR SURVIVAL STARTS HERE

You discover an old, rusty bunker buried in the wasteland. Can you turn it into an unstoppable military fortress?

🔨 REBUILD YOUR BUNKER – Tear down rusty fences, build massive walls, expand underground and transform your abandoned bunker into a powerful military base.

💰 BUILD YOUR EMPIRE – Place droppers and conveyors, upgrade your income, unlock new upgrades and rebirth for permanent bonuses.

🧟 SURVIVE THE ZOMBIE APOCALYPSE – Defend your bunker against deadly zombie waves using powerful turrets, lasers and advanced defenses.

☢️ DOMINATE OTHER PLAYERS – Launch nukes at rival bases straight from your command room!

⚔️ EXPLORE & FIGHT – Battle for control of the hill in the ruined city, collect valuable loot drops, drive vehicles and unlock 19 unique weapons.
